The offers, sales and issuances of the Convertible Notes were exempt from registration under the Securities Act in reliance on Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and Rule 506(b) of Regulation D promulgated thereunder as transactions by an issuer not involving a public offering. Each purchaser of the Convertible Notes represented that it was an accredited investor within the meaning of Rule 501(a) of Regulation D. The purchasers of the Convertible Notes represented their intention to acquire the Convertible Notes for investment only and not with a view to or for sale in connection with any distribution thereof, appropriate legends were placed on the Convertible Notes, and the purchasers had adequate access, through their relationships with us, to information about us. The Convertible Notes were offered and sold without any general solicitation or advertising, no underwriters or placement agents were involved, and no underwriting discounts or commissions were paid.

The grants of stock options and the issuances of shares of common stock upon the exercise of stock options described above were exempt from registration under the Securities Act in reliance on Rule 701 promulgated under the Securities Act, as transactions pursuant to compensatory benefit plans or contracts relating to compensation as provided under Rule 701, or, to the extent applicable, Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act, as transactions by an issuer not involving a public offering. The recipients of these securities were our employees, directors or bona fide consultants and received the securities under our 2020 Plan. Appropriate legends were affixed to the shares of common stock issued upon the exercise of stock options. No underwriters were involved in these transactions, and no underwriting discounts or commissions were paid. On October 15, 2026, we filed a registration statement on Form S-8 under the Securities Act to register all of the shares of our common stock subject to outstanding options and all shares of our common stock otherwise issuable pursuant to our equity compensation plans.

On October 16, 2026, immediately prior to the closing of our IPO, all outstanding shares of our convertible preferred stock automatically converted into an aggregate of 28,524,929 shares of our common stock, and, in connection with the closing of our IPO, the Convertible Notes automatically converted into an aggregate of 4,949,237 shares of our common stock. The issuances of these shares of common stock were exempt from registration pursuant to Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act.

Use of Proceeds from Initial Public Offering

In connection with our IPO, we issued and sold an aggregate of 10,781,250 shares of our common stock at a price to the public of $16.00 per share, consisting of 9,375,000 shares sold at the initial closing on October 16, 2026 and 1,406,250 shares sold on October 20, 2026 pursuant to the underwriters’ exercise of their option to purchase additional shares. J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, Jefferies LLC, BofA Securities, Inc. and Citigroup Global Markets Inc. acted as joint book-running managers and as representatives of the several underwriters for the offering.

The offer and sale of our common stock were registered under the Securities Act pursuant to our registration statement on Form S-1 (File No. 333-299057), which was declared effective by the SEC on October 14, 2026.

We received aggregate gross proceeds from our IPO of approximately $172.5 million. We incurred underwriting discounts and commissions of approximately $12.1 million and other offering expenses of approximately $4.4 million, for total expenses of approximately $16.5 million, resulting in net proceeds to us of approximately $156.0 million. No payments for such expenses were made directly or indirectly to (i) any of our directors or officers or their associates, (ii) any persons owning 10% or more of any class of our equity securities or (iii) any of our affiliates.

There has been no material change in the planned use of proceeds from our IPO as described in the Prospectus. Pending such uses, we have invested the net proceeds in short-term, investment-grade, interest-bearing instruments.
